purpose: What a good case is, item by item. MACHINE items are decided by kit or engine checks. SECOND-MODEL items are scored 0 to 3 by the optional S6 craft review (a cheap self-check, or a different model for independence). HUMAN items come from the player after play, through feedback_form.json. Scores are numbers only; no story text is ever recorded.

items.text: All engine fair-play rules pass.
Every solution fact has two independent routes, one of them search-free.
Cognitive budget respected: suspects, locations, critical strings.
No banned phrase, meta word or confession in player-facing text.
Options length-normalised; every distractor names a real entity.
Names, times and codes preserved exactly everywhere.
Every text claims only its assigned facts.
Findings and assessment kept apart; assessments carry their voice.
Varied document forms, each with an author, a reader and an in-world reason.
Each suspect appears in several hands and once outside the crime.
Hook: the first documents raise a human question a reader wants answered regardless of the puzzle.
Lived-in cast: each named person has wants, obligations and a life that shows on the page, beyond the crime.
Blind voice test: with headers removed, authors can be told apart by syntax and attention.
The turn is earned: the masking document reads innocently, and the reframe works on paper already held.
The herring induces real early suspicion and is refuted cleanly by findable paper.
Diegetic integrity: every document would exist if nobody ever investigated.
Semantic honesty: titles, subjects and findings describe and never conclude.
No quirk for its own sake: every trait changes what a person does, notices or hides.
The truth changes the meaning of the human question; the motive is understandable.
Register: calm, archival, specific, restrained; feeling carried by particulars.
I wanted to open the next record.
The turn felt like mine.
The people felt real.
The world felt like it went on outside the records.
The ending stayed with me.
It was fair.
A cross-family blind solver gets every question right, citing only valid documents.
With options alone, no answer is guessable above chance plus the margin.
